newsitem.title: USA: U S West seeks to overturn line lease rules.
newsitem.headline: U S West seeks to overturn line lease rules.

text.p: U S West Inc on Friday asked a federal court to overturn a Colorado Public Utilities Commission order that set rules on the leasing of the company's telephone lines to competitors seeking to provide local telephone service.
"By implementing agreements which do not address actual cost and appropriate prices for services, the commissioners have placed U S West at a significant competitive disadvantage," the lawsuit said.

U S West said the PUC order would cause it "immediate and irreparable harm, including loss of its customer base, harm to its good will and reputation, loss of revenues, the inability to negotiate with other competitors on a fair and equal basis and damage to its substantial investment in its telecommunications network.
The lawsuit, filed in the 10th U.S. Circuit Court in Denver, names the PUC commissioners, MFS Communciations Co Inc, Teleport Communicaitons Group Inc and ICG Telecom Group Inc.
